title: fix(motion): 2D Contour tab width is the bridge that stays, not the centre-path gap
body:
## What changed

2D Contour tabs now leave a bridge of the tab width that the user sets.

- `ring::tab_window` (new): the start tab window on the tool-centre ring is `tab_width + tool_diameter`. `tab_bridge::fit_tabs` grows it at corners and for leads (see "Review fixes"). Before, it was `tab_width` alone. The cutter disc removes `D/2` more material past each window end, so the bridge on the channel centre line was `tab_width - D`. A tab width of `D` or less left no bridge, and the part came free with no message.
- `tab_bridge.rs` (new): when the tab windows fill the whole loop, or no bridge of the tab width fits, the tabbed levels of that loop cut nothing. The operation shows a note that starts with `tabs:`. Before, this was silent.
- `contour.rs` calls `tab_bridge::cached` and `keep_cut` (506 lines; it was 517 before this PR).

## Readings

- Square 40 x 40, 6 mm cutter, outside contour, bottom level tabbed:
  - 4 tabs of 6 mm: four bridges of 6.0 mm (before: none).
  - 4 tabs of 5 mm: four bridges of 5.0 mm (before: none, the cuts overlapped by 1 mm).
  - 3 tabs of 10 mm: three bridges of 10.0 mm (before: 4 mm).
- `tabs_hold_the_part_until_the_floor`: the tabbed level is `4 x (6 + 10) = 64` mm shorter than the full ring (measured 64.0017 mm; the 1.7 um comes from window ends that fall on corner arcs).

## Pinning tests

- `crates/motion/tests/contour_tabs.rs` (new): measures each bridge as the swept disc of the posted feeds against points on the tool-centre ring. Five tests, including the fill note.
- `crates/motion/tests/machining2d.rs`:
  - `tabs_hold_the_part_until_the_floor`: new length.
  - `contour_tabs_stand_down_the_entry_arms` and `contour_hop_rides_the_tall_tab_top`: these used four 6 mm tabs with a 10 mm tool on a 40 mm centre ring. No tab can stand there. They now use two 4 mm tabs; their asserts did not change.
- `crates/app/tests/first_router_part.rs`: in `examples/first-router-part.camproj`, only the cached moves of `2D Contour1` change (see "Review fixes"). The format version and the drill note come from main.
- `crates/app/tests/first_part_programs.rs`: `examples/first-router-part.nc` is recorded again with `camcraft-cli process`. Only the `2D Contour1` tab-gap lines change (lines 116-148).

## Gate

First version (b755c8e). The current gate is in "Review fixes". `cargo xtask gate quick`: 22 steps, 0 failed (motion lib and the touched motion suites, app `arc_entry`, `solid_law_goldens`, `wall_arc_entry`). Then `first_router_part`: 4 passed after the regenerate. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

- No air cut on a machine.
- Control compensation (G41/G42) rings use the same window; on a straight wall the bridge is the same. Not measured separately.
- Wire EDM tabs (`wire_edm/tabs.rs`) are a different law and are not changed.

## Decision

`docs/decisions/2480-tab-bridge-width.md`.

## Review fixes (maintainer, commit 613ba4abf)

The review found two blockers. The rule is now on the true material: the smallest distance between the swept discs on the two sides of a tab, with the leads included, is at least `W - tol`.

- **B1, corners.** A window of `W + D` measures arc length on the centre line. At a corner the chord is shorter, so the true neck fell under `W` with no message.
- **B2, leads.** Linear, Arc and Tangential leads reach back into the tab window and cut into the bridge with no message.

Choices (`docs/decisions/2480-tab-bridge-width.md`, "Review fixes"):

- B1: grow the windows until the true neck is `W`. Moving the tab centres was considered and dropped.
- B2: widen the windows by the lead reach. Refusing leads with tabs was considered and dropped.
- New module `crates/motion/src/machining2d/tab_bridge.rs`: `fit_tabs` grows each window in bounded rounds (64 at most). Each round measures the keep tail (walk end and lead-out) against the next keep head (lead-in and walk start). The fit is cached per ring for each band.
- `ring::tabs_fill_note` is replaced by `tabs:` notes in `tab_bridge.rs`. When the windows fill the loop, the operation shows a note. This is a note, not a refusal.

Measured, square 40 x 40, D 6, 4 tabs, smallest bridge (before -> after):

| Lead | W 3 | W 6 | W 10 |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 3 -> 3 | 6 -> 6 | 10 -> 10 |
| Perpendicular 4 | 3 -> 3 | 6 -> 6 | 10 -> 10 |
| Linear 4 | -5 -> 3 | -2 -> 6 | 2 -> 10 |
| Arc r3 | -3 -> 3 | 0 -> 6 | 4 -> 10 |
| Tangential r2 | -1 -> 3 | 2 -> 6 | 6 -> 10 |

Corners: inside 10 x 10 corner -0.10 -> 4.10 (W 4); picked start on an outside corner, W 4: 1.42 -> 4.0; W 1.5: -> 1.5; bore: 3.82 -> 4.13 (W 4).

Pins (`crates/motion/tests/contour_tab_bridge.rs`, new):

- `inside_corner_tabs_keep_the_tab_width`
- `outside_tab_centred_on_a_corner_from_a_picked_start`
- `bore_tabs_keep_the_tab_width`
- `every_lead_family_keeps_the_tab_width`
- `inside_and_conventional_straight_walls_keep_the_tab_width`

Red proof: with the initial `W + D` windows only, 5 of these tests fail (inside corner -0.10, picked corner 1.42, inside straight with Arc -1.0, Linear W 3 -5.0, bore 3.82). This includes (a) and the lead case.

Old pins that follow the wider windows:

- `contour_tabs.rs`: the `at_least` comment now says that it measures the centre-line run. `a_wide_tab_keeps_its_full_width` accepts a longer run where a tab sits on a corner arc.
- `machining2d.rs::tabs_hold_the_part_until_the_floor`: the held length is 64.64 mm, not 64, because the window ends on corner arcs grow.
- `machining2d.rs::contour_tabs_stand_down_the_entry_arms`: the tabs sat on the corners of the 10 x 10 inside ring with a neck of -0.10 mm (no bridge). Now they grow, and the floor walks round the two other corners as flat arcs. The helix check skips flat arcs.

Example: `examples/first-router-part.camproj` changes only in the cached moves of 2D Contour1. The keep ends move 3 mm from each tab (the Arc r3 lead reach). The stamp and the other operations are not changed.

Gate:

- `contour_tab_bridge` 5/5, `contour_tabs` 5/5, `machining2d` 68/68, `contour_whole` 8/8, motion lib machining2d 208 passed, `first_router_part` 4/4.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick`: 120 steps, 118 passed. Two failed: app `thread_boss` and `thread_mill`. Their `.nc` goldens are stale (tool numbers T01/T03 swapped). The same test fails on the PR head b755c8e without this commit, so it is not from this change.

Not exercised: no air cut; G41/G42 rings not measured; `blend_turns` fillets with tabs not pinned; whole-model bands only through `contour_whole`; band boundaries (#2460) not changed; the time of the 64 rounds not measured.

### Second review (head 62815c223)

Both reviews of 613ba4abf had one blocker: `examples/first-router-part.nc` was stale.

- Main (9d6b57c09, with #2560) is merged into the branch. The merge had no conflict.
- `examples/first-router-part.nc` is recorded again with `camcraft-cli process`. Against main, 25 lines change (lines 116-148), all `2D Contour1` tab gaps. Example: `Y86.991` -> `Y80.991`. The G73 line stays as main recorded it. No guide or site page quotes the changed lines.
- `tab_bridge.rs`: a NaN bridge distance counts as short (`gap.is_nan() || gap < need - SLACK`).
- `tab_bridge.rs`: if `count * (W + D)` is at least the loop length, the fit gives the fill note before it reserves one entry for each tab.
- `contour_tab_bridge.rs`: the fixtures that fit assert `n == count`. New test `a_huge_tab_count_fills_the_loop_without_a_huge_allocation` (`u32::MAX` tabs).
- The decision file records the known limit N2: the fit compares only neighbouring cuts within `W + D` of each walk end.

Gate on 62815c223:

| Binary | Result |
|---|---|
| motion `contour_tab_bridge` | 6 passed |
| motion `contour_tabs` | 5 passed |
| motion `machining2d` | 68 passed |
| motion `contour_whole` | 8 passed |
| motion `contour_start` | 21 passed |
| motion lib | 434 passed, 10 ignored |
| app `first_part_programs` | 2 passed |
| app `first_router_part` | 4 passed |
| app `example_catalog` | 2 passed |
| app `thread_mill` | 8 passed |
| app `thread_boss` | 12 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not proved red: the huge-count test. Without the check, it reserves about 137 GB and stops the process.

Changelog: 2D Contour: the tab width is now the width of the bridge that stays on the part (the tab window on the tool path is the tab width plus the tool diameter). Before, a tab width equal to or less than the tool diameter left no tab, and the part came free. At corners and with Linear, Arc or Tangential leads, the gaps on the tool path grow so that the bridge stays the tab width. Saved projects with tabs get wider gaps on the next generate.

Fixes #2480
